_comment: Candidates produced by Agent 1.2, consumed in order by Agent 0. Each item moves through statuses: scouted -> image_sourced -> animated -> sound_sourced -> assembled -> gated -> published | quarantined.

queue.visual_theme: Rain-streaked floor-to-ceiling penthouse window at night, glittering city skyline lights below and slightly out of focus, warm amber lamp glow reflected on the glass, a single dark leather armchair silhouette in the near foreground, moody desaturated blue-black exterior against warm interior tones, cinematic depth of field, no visible logos, no readable text, no people/faces
queue.mood: slow ambient piano with a light continuous rain layer underneath, warm sustained pads, no percussion, no vocals, sub-60bpm, gentle and spacious, subtly building but never dramatic
queue.title: 1 Hour of Discipline | Rainy City Ambience for Deep Focus & Manifestation
queue.seo_description: A quiet hour of rain against a penthouse window overlooking the city, made for deep focus, studying, journaling, or manifesting your next level. Let the ambience carry you into stillness while you work toward the life you're building. Perfect for study sessions, late-night reflection, or falling asleep to calm city rain. #ambience #motivation #manifestation #rain #discipline #deepfocus #studywithme #luxurylifestyle #selfimprovement #citylights
queue.target_length_note: Deliberately chosen at the low end of the allowed [60,600] range for this first long-form cycle to keep compute/storage/upload cost reasonable while the pipeline is validated end-to-end.
queue.scouting_method_note: Brief was NOT produced by literally watching the 5 reference videos in config/channel.json (no video-watching capability available in this environment) — it was informed by their URLs/context plus general knowledge of the established 'motivational luxury ambient' YouTube niche conventions (rain-on-window / city skyline / fireplace / warm-lit moody interiors, 'X Hours of [mood] | [purpose] Ambience' title pattern). No live web trend search was performed for this cycle either; this is a judgement-based brief, not a data-verified one.
queue.content_exclusions_screen: No political figures, parties, policy, or controversial social topics present in title/description/tags. Passes shared_gates.factual_controversy_screen and platform_policy_check on inspection.
queue.pipeline_blocker: Stage 2.2 (Image Sourcer) could not run: the `banana` skill requires a Google AI (Gemini) API key (GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY) which is not configured anywhere in this environment (no env var, no MCP server registration, no ~/.banana config, no gcloud ADC credentials found). No image was generated. Per the image_copyright_gate this is a hard blocker, not something to work around with a non-banana-generated placeholder. Consequently Stage 3.2 (Animator, needs the image) and Stage 5 (Assembler, needs the animated loop) were not attempted. Status remains 'scouted' rather than advancing to 'image_sourced'.
queue.audio_track_id_provisional: Rain _ Sleep _ Meditation (HoliznaCC0) — sourced and verified during this cycle for when the pipeline is unblocked; see state/cc0_audio_library.json. Not written to audio_track_id/status sound_sourced because per pipeline order that field is only meant to be set once the candidate has actually reached the sound_sourced stage (i.e. after image_sourced/animated), and this candidate is still stuck at scouted.
